notes: Two additions: (1) Optional Groq fallback — add a free Groq API key in Settings → Engine & Keys and, when streaming fails, Groq Whisper is tried before the slower Google batch. (2) New Rewrite preset 'Repeat মুছে সাজাও' — removes repeated phrases and lays text out in paragraphs and bullets. Rollback to v1.44 is available in the App Update card.
